scope: Six primary research papers and two official repository inspections relevant to observation confirmation. This is a selective research map, not an institutional ranking or an exhaustive frontier survey.
access: Public web pages, papers and unauthenticated GitHub metadata only. No upstream code executed, no model weights downloaded, no private systems accessed.

papers.title: The Lessons of Developing Process Reward Models in Mathematical Reasoning
papers.finding: A score for reaching the correct final answer is not equivalent to correctness of the current reasoning step. The paper studies consensus filtering and evaluates both answer selection and error localization.
papers.transfer_inference: Measure whether a confirmation corrected a specific observation separately from final accuracy and cost. A good final answer must not erase an earlier failed verification.
papers.limitation: Mathematical reasoning experiments with learned judges; neither universal verification nor independent evidence from the physical world. The paper reports a remaining gap to its sampling upper bound. We have not reproduced its benchmark results.
papers.adoption: Conceptual evaluation design only; no weights or repository code imported.

papers.title: DeepSeekMath-V2: Towards Self-Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning
papers.finding: The verifier can predict the correct score while inventing a fault. A meta-verifier assesses whether the reported fault exists and justifies that score; generator self-assessment is trained rather than presumed reliable.
papers.transfer_inference: Preserve a challenge and its supporting observation as separate records; test a second channel that can disagree with the first. Reviewer agreement must not be equated with independent ground truth.
papers.limitation: The reported results concern theorem proving with substantial model and verification compute. A learned meta-verifier is not a formal proof checker or a guarantee against correlated error. Benchmark claims remain author-reported here.
papers.adoption: Independent implementation of a synthetic confirmation experiment; no DeepSeek weights or code imported.

papers.title: Layer-Resolved Optimal Transport for Hallucination Detection in NMT and Abstractive Summarization
papers.group: Faculty of Applied Sciences, Ukrainian Catholic University, Lviv
papers.finding: Attention geometry detects some source-disengagement failures, but transfers poorly to summaries that attend to relevant text while misrepresenting it. Results vary by failure type and decoder layer.
papers.transfer_inference: Separate bad measurements from bad interpretations. Add stress conditions in which observations look internally consistent but support a wrong explanation; do not treat a single uncertainty signal as a general truth detector.
papers.limitation: A 2026 preprint stating workshop acceptance, with bounded translation and summarization experiments. This review does not reproduce them or infer an institution-wide ranking.
papers.adoption: Failure taxonomy only; no attention detector, datasets or model weights imported.

papers.title: Entity Embellishment Mitigation in LLMs Output with Noisy Synthetic Dataset for Alignment
papers.group: West Ukrainian National University; author also affiliated with Arval Leasing Solutions BNP Paribas
papers.finding: Creates deliberately embellished summaries for preference alignment, retaining a reference summary. The paper distinguishes plausible added information from information actually supported by the source.
papers.transfer_inference: Generate controlled corruption with known provenance and preserve the uncorrupted counterpart. Plausibility and factual truth do not establish that a particular observation supports an inference.
papers.limitation: Ukrainian summarization experiment; human validation uses only 50 articles. The author explicitly notes small-sample limits and bias in automatic LLM evaluation. No claim of general robustness is supported.
papers.adoption: Controlled synthetic negative examples as a design idea; no paper text, datasets, models or code copied into training.

papers.title: Semantic Uncertainty: Linguistic Invariances for Uncertainty Estimation in Natural Language Generation
papers.group: Oxford Applied and Theoretical Machine Learning, University of Oxford
papers.finding: Clusters sampled answers by contextual semantic equivalence before estimating entropy. This distinguishes uncertainty about meaning from variation in wording.
papers.transfer_inference: Count distinct underlying evidence and semantic claims, not repeated strings or paraphrases. In our discrete task, repeated answers from the same channel should retain their shared provenance.
papers.limitation: Uncertainty estimation, not ground-truth verification. Equivalence judgments and sampling can fail; a consistently wrong source can have low semantic entropy. That last failure is a direct design inference, not a reproduced benchmark result.
papers.adoption: Evaluation and provenance principle only; no semantic-clustering model integrated.

papers.title: Deep Adaptive Design: Amortizing Sequential Bayesian Experimental Design
papers.group: Department of Statistics, University of Oxford
papers.finding: Trains a design policy before deployment to choose subsequent experiments from accumulated observations, amortizing sequential Bayesian design computation.
papers.transfer_inference: Model confirmation as a paid action and assess its expected value before buying it. Compare a learned selector to an explicit decision rule using identical budgets and observation channels.
papers.limitation: Its information-gain objective and model assumptions differ from our accuracy-minus-cost task. Our work is not a reproduction of DAD and adaptive experimental design is established prior art.
papers.adoption: Prior-art boundary and sequential-design framing; no upstream code imported.

repositories.read_scope: README, root tree and LICENSE; paper method sections read separately.
repositories.admission: Study only. Repository license observation does not admit all dependencies, datasets or future model artifacts automatically.

repositories.license_observation: GitHub repository metadata returned null license; root tree at this revision has README.md and evaluation, with no root license file. This does not determine licenses of separately hosted models.
repositories.read_scope: README and root tree; PRM paper method sections read separately.
repositories.admission: Study only. No repository code copying authorized by this inspection.

recommendations.status: research recommendation; implementation status belongs in build receipts
recommendations.idea: Offer a second observation whose independence or correlation is explicitly modeled; charge its real cost and allow the policy to stop.
recommendations.test: Compare no-confirmation, always-confirm, random and adaptive confirmation on paired episodes, including clean, independently corrupted and correlated-error conditions.

recommendations.status: research recommendation; implementation status belongs in build receipts
recommendations.idea: Retain observation provenance, challenged claim and resulting prediction separately.
recommendations.test: Report final accuracy, utility, confident error, false alarms and actual corrupt-observation correction. Include a condition where all available channels agree on the same wrong answer.

claims_not_supported: That SZL established AGI or an unprecedented architecture.
That these are the highest-ranked institutions in their countries.
That any cited paper's benchmark was independently reproduced here.
That self-consistency or multiple model votes establishes independent evidence.
That the synthetic confirmation experiment establishes real-world LLM factuality.
